name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate workings of engines. Growing up in Soweto, he spent hours tinkering with old cars and motorcycles, developing a knack for understanding mechanical systems. He honed his skills through a vocational program, earning certifications in machining and fabrication. Eager to apply his knowledge to racing, Thabo seeks a team where he can learn and contribute to the meticulous work required to build and maintain high-performance machinery. 

While relatively new to professional motorsport, Thabo approaches his work with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset. He understands the importance of precision and reliability in racing, and he is committed to delivering high-quality work under pressure. His eagerness to learn from experienced colleagues and his dedication to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to any racing team looking for a promising machinist.

physical.description: Thabo has a strong build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and measurements.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on intricate tasks.
Keeps a meticulously organized toolbox, with each tool in its designated spot.
